a.lede: New research shows the most advanced AI models from China were trained on banned Nvidia chips.
a.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh oh, Jensen!

b.lede: Researchers pinpoint that DeepSeek, Kimi, and other Chinese AI models were trained on export-controlled Nvidia Blackwell chips — statistical analysis on model weights reveals high correlation to Nvidia hardware
b.title: Researchers allege DeepSeek, Kimi, and other Chinese AI models were trained using banned Nvidia Blackwell GPUs
